scope: Evaluate combined benefit; no independent-performance gate for each edit.
analysis: All pairs pooled by identical DLL hashes; report median paired CPU/wall reductions, summed-time differences, group variation, win/tie counts. No group unanimity or positive CI lower bound requirement.
positive_evidence: Pooled CPU and wall reductions positive: advance the bundle to full semantic and deployment checks even if some independent groups reverse. Report uncertainty, not a precise guaranteed gain.
unclear_evidence: Retain as inconclusive when signs conflict or effect is small versus variation; allow one bounded extra independent group or later composition, rather than discard individual edits.
clear_regression: Consistent CPU and wall slowdown across complete groups and pooled evidence: keep source and data as lower-priority, without treating this as proof each component is ineffective.
hard_gates: 2604 strict original per-event and unchanged C++ event hashes
continuous24 each>=50 raw fights/s before deployment
same DLL SHA, training entry and runtime manifest
target: 100/125/140 fights per second at observed-range 20% background load; fitted value cannot replace raw gates
